verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: Send men to you, and let them take possession of the land of Canaan. I have given it to the children of Israel as a gift. One man after another, from each family, should go there. Send all the men who are fit to go there.
verses.3: And Moses sent them out from the desert of Paran, by the command of Yahweh. They were all men, the leaders of the Israelites.
verses.4: And these are the names of them: Mete-Ruben Shamu’a, son of Zakhur.
verses.5: To Shemuel, Shaphan judged the son of Huri.
verses.6: To the people of Judah, there is a cat, son of Yefunah.
verses.7: To Ishmael, son of Yosef, may he be saved.
verses.8: To Ephraim, who is to be saved.
verses.9: To Mathe Benyamin Palti, son of Rapu.
verses.10: To Zebulun Gadiel, son of Sodai.
verses.11: To Josaphat, to Menashe Gadiy, son of Susei.
verses.12: To Dane Amiel, son of Gammal.
verses.13: For the sake of the son of Michal.
verses.14: To Naphthali, my son, I am humble.
verses.15: To Matti Gad Gueuel, son of Makhi.
verses.16: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to conquer the land. Moses called upon Yehoshua to lead them.
verses.17: And Moses sent them to conquer the land of Canaan. He said to them, “Go up onto the mountain.” So they went up the mountain.
verses.18: And when you see what the land is like, and the people who live on it, then you will realize that the strong ones will be weakened, while the weak ones will become stronger.
verses.19: And what kind of land does he live in? Is it a good land, or is it a bad one? And what kind of cities does he live in there? Are they peaceful cities, or are they places of oppression?
verses.20: And what kind of land is this beautiful land? Is it a land where there are trees and vines? And they grow strong, and they take the fruits from that land. And those days are days of picking grapes.
verses.21: And they went up and crossed the land from the desert of Zin to Rehoboth-Labah.
verses.22: And they went up to the mountain, and arrived at Hebron. There were Ahiman, Shushai, and Talmai, who were descendants of Anak. Hebron was built seven years before the Israelites came into the land.
verses.23: They went up to the stream of Eshkol. There, they picked some grapes from it. They carried those grapes in two bags, along with them from the mountains and from the valleys.
verses.24: To that place it was named “Nahal Eshkol”. It’s the name given to the river where the children of Israel drank from.
verses.25: And they returned from the land after forty days.
verses.26: And they went and came to Moses, Aaron, and all the tribes of Israel. They arrived at the holy land of Sinai. Moses explained everything to them and told them about all the laws of the land. Then they saw the fruits of the land.
verses.27: And they told him, “We have come to the land that you sent us to. And there is also milk and vegetables there.”
verses.28: May the people who live in those lands and cities be blessed! They have suffered great hardships. And we also saw children who were born there.
verses.29: Amalek will dwell in the land of Negev, Hittite, and Yehuvi. The Canaanites will dwell on the mountains.
verses.30: And the dog led the people to Moses. He said, “Come here, and let us inherit her, as we are able to do.”
verses.31: And the men who went with him said, “We cannot climb up to the people, because he is stronger than us.”
verses.32: And they brought forth the word of the Lord, saying, “This is the land we have crossed over to. It is a land where its inhabitants can live in peace. And all the people we saw living there were men from Midian.”
verses.33: And there we saw those giants, children of giants. They appeared to us as little creatures. And in their eyes, we also appeared to be little creatures.
